t: Overview: Prefabricated Bridge Girders with Built-In Sensors
title: Overview: Prefabricated Bridge Girders with Built-In Sensors
description: Bridge girders manufactured with embedded sensors — structures born instrumented. The built world is humanity's biggest artifact: better construction and manufacturing make it faster, cheaper, and greener. This database covers all the pieces needed to make it: core components, materials, processes, software, and subsystems, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Every record is the full entry with definitions, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

title: Signature design: Glossary & Quick Reference
description: Signature design: The working vocabulary of Prefabricated Bridge Girders with Built-In Sensors: CLT, BIM, WAAM, ICF, UHPC, R-value, Cure, Tolerance.
definition: Glossary for Prefabricated Bridge Girders with Built-In Sensors.
key_points: CLT: Cross-laminated timber — structural wood panels.
BIM: Building information modeling — the digital twin of a project.
WAAM: Wire arc additive manufacturing — welding-based 3D printing.
ICF: Insulated concrete forms — foam blocks filled with concrete.
UHPC: Ultra-high performance concrete — exceptionally strong mix.
R-value: Insulation rating — higher resists heat flow better.
Cure: The chemical hardening of concrete and resins.
Tolerance: Allowed deviation — tighter means more precise.
how_it_works: Learn the terms before the details.
Use the demo as a flash drill.
Add your own terms as you learn.
Teach the vocabulary to your team.
